I replied to Pree in the #central-team thread. I noted that the signed order form for Tansley Parcel is due 25 August. I also pointed out that it's already 14 October, so 25 August this year has passed, and asked her to correct the date if she meant 25 August next year or a different day.

A deadline date is an operational fact, not a finance figure, so it was fine to repeat in the channel. She said no action was needed, so I didn't send mail or create a calendar entry.
